source: 594 Execution
target: 594 Executio

source: Franca almost chuckled in exasperation at Bard’s remark.
target: Franca paene subrisit, exasperata, ad verba Bardi.

source: April Fool’s not only deceived outsiders but also themselves.
target: April Fool’s non solum externos, sed etiam se ipsos decipiebat.

source: If they didn’t believe in Celestial Worthy, cooperation wouldn’t be on the table.
target: Nisi in Caelestis Digno crederent, cooperatio in mensa non esset.

source: Bard delved into his knowledge about Castle Dylan.
target: Bardus in scientia sua de Castrum Dylan perscrutatus est.

source: “That ancient castle used to be the domain of a secret organization known as the Secret Order.
target: "Iste antiquum castrum olim erat dominium organizationis secretae, quae Ordo Secretus appellabatur.

source: Loki became a member of the organization when he transmigrated.
target: Loki membrum organizationis factus est cum se transmigravit.

source: The story goes that the initial leader of the Secret Order personally constructed the ancient castle and concealed it over a century ago.”
target: Fabula narrat primum ducem Ordo Secretus, qui ipse antiquum castrum condidit et eum ante centum annos celavit.

source: Curious, Franca inquired, “Who’s leading the Secret Order now?”
target: Cum curiositate, Franca rogavit: "Quis nunc ducit Ordo Secretus?"

source: Bard shook his head slowly.
target: Bardus caput lente concussit.

source: “Loki is in the dark about that too.
target: "Loki etiam de hoc ignorat.

source: Only those who’ve become Bizarro Sorcerers or Sequence 4 demigods within the Secret Order can meet the leader and establish a connection with him.
target: Solum illi, qui in Ordo Secretus facti sunt Magi Bizarro aut demigodi Sequentiae IV, possunt ducem convenire atque cum eo vinculum instituere.

source: Others merely follow the orders of their direct superiors.
target: Reliqui tantum praecepta superiorum eorum sequuntur.

source: “Loki once contemplated murdering his mentor, his immediate superior in the Secret Order, to gain the Bizarro Sorcerer Beyonder characteristic and stage a grand performance.
target: Olim Loki meditatus est de occidendo praeceptor suo, superiori proximus in Ordo Secretus, ut sibi proprietatem Beyonder, quam Magi Bizarro habent, adipiscatur atque magnum spectaculum constituat.

source: Yet, due to his comprehension and fear of Bizarro Sorcerers, he never solidified this idea into a concrete plan.
target: Attamen, propter intellectum suum et metum Magorum Bizarro, hanc mentem in consilium concretum numquam transformavit.

source: Eventually, he gathered all the Bizarro Sorcerer potion ingredients in Castle Dylan and entirely abandoned his initial scheme.
target: Postremo, omnes ingredimenta potionis Magorum Bizarro in Castrum Dylan congregavit atque prorsus consilium suum initiale reliquit.

source: “Do you think a hidden place like Castle Dylan, with its long history, would be quiet, cold, and sinister?
target: "Putasne locum occultum sicut Castrum Dylan, cum longa historia, esse quietum, frigidum, et sinistrum?

source: Contrary to expectations, Loki informed me that it’s quite lively, featuring a grand performance every day.”
target: Contra exspectationes, Loki mihi dixit eum valde vivum esse, ostentando magnum spectaculum cotidie.

source: A grand performance… Hela recalled the pitch‐black ancient castle she had glimpsed in Loki’s dream, along with the wax‐statue‐like guests inside.
target: Magnum spectaculum… Hela recordata est castrum antiquum atrum, quod in somnio Loki intuerat, atque hospitibus similes statuis ceratis.

source: Deep in thought, Lumian asked Bard, “How do you suggest we locate Castle Dylan?”
target: Mente profunda versatus, Lumian Bardum interrogavit: "Quomodo suades ut Castrum Dylan inveniamus?"

source: “I’m still missing crucial clues,” Bard admitted sincerely.
target: "Adhuc indicia crucialia mihi deficiunt," Bardus sincere confitebatur.

source: If finding Castle Dylan were that straightforward, the current leader of the Secret Order would have seized it and ousted Loki.
target: Si Castrum Dylan tam facile inveniretur, dux praesentis Ordinis Secretus iam eum ceperet et Loki removeret.

source: No, he would’ve turned Loki into his puppet.
target: Minime, Loki in instrumentum suum converteret.

source: Lumian intended to inquire more thoroughly with Ludwig later, seeking any information he might have gained after consuming half of Loki’s arm.
target: Lumian postea cum Ludovico plenius interrogare intendebat, quaerens notitiam quam postquam dimidium brachii Loki comederat adeptus fuisset.

source: “What about Hisoka? What insights do you have on Hisoka?” Lumian inquired.
target: "Quid de Hisoka? Quas notitias de Hisoka habes?" Lumian interrogavit.

source: Bard seemed to recollect something.
target: Bardus aliquid recordari videbatur.

source: “That guy doesn’t quite fit in.
target: "Ille non prorsus convenit.

source: He prefers going solo.
target: Se solus agere mavult.

source: The rare instances of collaboration are mostly with Mad Lady.
target: Rarae occasiones collaborationis plerumque sunt cum Mad Lady.

source: We all sense his emotions are pretty unpredictable, swinging between joy and anger.
target: Omnes sentimus affectus eius esse satis incertos, inter gaudium et iram oscillantes.

source: Mad Lady, however, remarked that he’s not pure enough.
target: Mad Lady autem dixit eum non satis purum esse.

source: He’s highly dangerous—on par with Loki.
target: Valde periculosus est, par loco cum Loki.

source: His specific path remains a mystery.
target: Iter eius peculiare adhuc mysterium manet.

source: I’ve witnessed him using his abilities twice, both times involving mystical items.
target: Eum bis facultates suas utentem vidi, utrumque tempore rebus mysticis innixum.

source: It’s a poker card that can change its face, showcasing the attributes of Frost and Cut respectively.
target: Est tessera ludica quae faciem mutare potest, attributa Frigoris et Secandi respective ostendens.

source: Word has it that Hisoka sought out an Artisan outside the Research Society to customize it after hunting a Beyonder.
target: Fama est quod Hisoka Artifex extra Societatem Investigationis quaesivit ad eam aptandam postquam Beyonder venatus est.

source: Regrettably, Mad Lady is dead, and there’s no means to commune with her spirit.
target: Infeliciter, Mad Lady mortua est, et nullus modus est ad eius spiritum communicandum.

source: She undoubtedly held more information about Hisoka…
target: Indubitanter plura de Hisoka habebat…

source: Does not being pure enough mean that Hisoka isn’t as unhinged as he appears?
target: Nonne quod non satis purus est, significat Hisoka non tam insanus esse quam videtur?

source: Is his occasional madness a deliberate facade?
target: Num insanitas eius occasionalis sit simulatio deliberata?

source: Lumian pondered with a twinge of regret.
target: Lumian, leviter paenitens, meditatus est.

source: Even though Lumian had obtained Mad Lady’s remains, her spirit had been severely corrupted by Celestial Worthy.
target: Quamquam Lumian reliquias Mad Lady obtinerat, spiritus eius a Caelestis Digno graviter corruptus erat.

source: Some of it had even been “washed away” by the power of the sea, completely obliterated.
target: Pars eius etiam potestate maris ablutam fuit, penitus deletam.

source: Lumian sighed quietly and shifted the conversation to a different topic.
target: Lumian quiete suspiravit et conversationem ad alium rem convertere constituit.

source: “Do you have insights into the sea’s power on Ultraman?”
target: "Habesne notitiam de potentia maris in Ultraman?"

source: “Indeed.”
target: "Certe."

source: Bard shared his findings candidly.
target: Bardus inventa sua candidissime enuntiavit.

source: I played a role in deciphering the extraterrestrial language, although the Celestial Worthy provided crucial revelations.
target: Partem egi in lingua extraterrena explicanda, quamquam Caelestis Digno revelationes cruciales contulit.

source: Additionally, the power of the sea is not exclusive to the offspring of Port Santa.
target: Praeterea, potentia maris non solum ad filios Portus Santae pertinet.

source: I once encountered two heretics in Lenburg with similar abilities, and I managed to extract corresponding knowledge from them.
target: Olim duo haereticos in Lenburg cum similibus facultatibus conveni, atque ex his notitiam correspondentem extraxi.

source: This information greatly aided my decryption efforts, revealing that this pathway is not solely tied to the sea.
target: Haec notitia conatus meos ad enodationem valde adiuvit, ostendens hanc viam non solum ad mare pertinere.

source: In fact, only a small portion of it involves the sea.
target: Re vera, solum parva pars eius ad mare attinet.

source: The power primarily emanates from the stars and the land beneath our feet.
target: Potentia primarie ex stellis et terra sub pedibus nostris procedit.

source: As you all are aware, our world is, after all, a planet.
target: Ut omnes scitis, mundus noster enim planeta appellatur.

source: The corresponding Sequence 9 is known as Astronomy Aficionado.
target: Sequens IX notus est ut Amator Astronomiae.

source: It focuses on acquiring knowledge of the cosmos, related information, an initial perception of reality, and enhancing one’s physique.
target: Illud intendit ad scientiam caeli et orbis acquirendam, informationes pertinentes, primam perceptionem realitatis, et augmentum corporis.

source: Sequence 8, named Star Worshiper, can decipher the Star Language or the Language of the Stars and receive insights into fate.
target: Sequens VIII, cui nomen est "Star Worshiper", linguam stellarum interpretari potest atque fata cognoscere.

source: Sequence 7, called Star Sacrificer, gains true powers through sacrificial rituals involving the stars.
target: Sequens VII, vocatus "Star Sacrificer", veras virtutes per ritus sacrificatorios stellis implicatos adipisci potest.

source: This encompasses Gravity Abnormality, Weakening Ray, Electromagnetic Attraction, and Cosmic Void.
target: Hoc comprehendit Anomaliam Gravitatis, Radiam Debilitantis, Attractionem Electromagneticam, et Vacuitatem Cosmica.

source: Sequence 6 is Navigator.
target: Sequens VI est Navigator.

source: They possess a deeper understanding of space and dimensions, allowing them to locate hidden passageways in the void and navigate and adjust routes between the stars.
target: Illi spatium et dimensiones profundius intellegunt, quae eos sinit vias occultas in vacuo invenire et itinera inter stellas navigare atque ordinare.

source: Navigating ships at sea becomes a straightforward task for them.
target: Naves in mari navigare eis negotium simplex fit.

source: Sequence 5, Tidal Scholar, further masters gravity and can whip up massive waves capable of shattering ships and demolishing docks.
target: Sequens V, Tidal Scholar, gravitatis scientiam ulterius dominatur et undas ingentes excitare potest, quae naves conterere et molas portuum delere valent.

source: As for Sequence 4, it’s known as Heavybringer.
target: Quoad Sequens IV, notus est ut Heavybringer.

source: Unfortunately, I’m not too certain about their specific abilities.
target: Infeliciter, de eorum facultatibus specificis non satis certus sum.

source: Lumian remained silent, taking a couple of steps back and signaling for Franca and the others to continue questioning.
target: Lumian silentium retinuebat, paucis gradibus retrorsum processit et Francam aliosque invitavit ut quaestiones continuarent.

source: His primary concern centered around Loki’s connection to Hisoka; anything else seemed less crucial.
target: Praecipua eius cura erat de nexu Loki ad Hisoka; cetera minus gravia videbantur.

source: Franca studied Bard for a moment before inquiring, “Have you recruited other members into April Fool’s?”
target: Franca Bardum observavit et deinde rogavit: "Aliosne membris April Fool's conduxisti?"

source: “Yes,” Bard admitted without hesitation.
target: "Ita," Bardus sine mora respondit.

source: After detailing what he knew about the April Fool’s members outside the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, Franca asked with curiosity, “Why did you choose the nickname Bard? Considering your past identity and current class, wouldn’t Kaitō or Kid be more fitting?”
target: Postquam enarravit quid de membris April Fool's extra Societatem Investigationis Curly-Haired Baboons sciret, Franca cum curiositate rogavit: "Cur cognomen Bard elegisti? Considerata enim tua identitas praeterita et classis hodierna, num non potius Kaitō aut Kid aptiora videantur?"

source: Bard responded calmly, “My current body was a bard, a wandering artist who often dabbled in thievery and swindling. He met his end when discovered trying to cheat others out of their money, suffering a severe beating.”
target: Bardus aequo animo respondit: "Corpus meum praesens erat bardus, errans artifex qui saepius in furtum et fraudes versabatur. Finem obiit cum deprehensus esset, eo quod tentabat alios pecunia decipere, et graviter verberatus est."

source: Cheat, swindle, and steal—Franca thought. You know everything; it suits you quite well.
target: Fraudare, fallere, et furari—Franca cogitavit. "Tu omnia scis; tibi valde convenit."

source: Franca turned to Hela and Gandalf, stating, “I have no further questions.”
target: Franca ad Hela et Gandalf conversus est, dicens: "Nullas alias quaestiones habeo."

source: “Neither do I,” Gandalf acknowledged, recognizing that Bard’s life was approaching its end.
target: "Neque ego," Gandalf agnoscens, intellexit vitam Bardi ad finem prope esse.

source: Muggle’s brother wouldn’t let him off the hook!
target: Frater Muggle eum non dimisit!

source: “Neither do I,” Hela added.
target: "Neque et ego," Hela addidit.

source: Lumian raised his right hand, generating a dark-green glow at his fingertips.
target: Lumian dextram manum elevavit, creando scintillam viridem obscuram in digitis suis.

source: The light transformed into a strange ray, penetrating Bard’s chest.
target: Lux in radium insolutum conversus est, quod in pectore Bardi penetrare coepit.

source: Weakening Ray!
target: Radius Debilitatrix!

source: Lumian still had access to a week’s worth of sea power, approaching the level of Sequence 5.
target: Lumian adhuc hebdomadam potentiae maris habuit, accedens ad gradum Sequentiae V.

source: Bard’s face contorted, muscles and nerves reacting instinctively.
target: Vultus Bardi contortus est, musculi et nervi instinctive reagentes.

source: His chest, close to his neck, rapidly melted and peeled, exposing the flesh beneath.
target: Pectus eius, prope collum situm, celeriter liquefactum est et excisum, ostendens carnem subtus.

source: Seeing this, Gandalf sighed again.
target: Hoc videns, Gandalf iterum suspiravit.

source: Gandalf sighed, condensing a straight sword with Sunrise Gleam and driving it towards Bard.
target: Gandalf suspiravit, gladium rectum cum fulgore aurorae stringens, et in Bardum impellens.

source: The light blade impaled Bard’s head, and he crumpled to the ground with a thud, held down by the sword.
target: Lamina lucida caput Bardi impigerat, atque ille cum strepitu ad terram cecidit, gladio adstrictus.

source: Bard writhed like a skinned insect, convulsing as life left his body.
target: Bardus quasi insectum excorticatum se contorquebat, convulsus, dum vita ex corpore eius exibat.

source: Lumian observed in silence, refraining from intervening as Gandalf freed Bard.
target: Lumian in silentio observavit, non interveniens dum Gandalf Bardum liberabat.

source: When Bard’s breath ceased, and he lay motionless, Lumian turned to Gandalf and Hela.
target: Cum spiritus Bardi cessaverit et ille immotus iacebat, Lumian ad Gandalf et Hela conversus est.

source: “Thank you for your assistance.”
target: "Gratias vobis ago pro auxilio."

source: “It’s our duty. We’re all accountable for the harm April Fool’s caused to the other members of the Research Society,” Gandalf responded gravely.
target: "Officium nostrum est. Omnes culpabiles sumus pro damno quod April Fool’s aliis membris Societatis Investigationis intulit," Gandalf graviter respondit.

source: Lumian didn’t contest.
target: Lumian non contradixit.

source: Instead, he disclosed, “Before the operation, I mentioned joining a secret organization before assuming my sister’s identity.
target: Proinde edixit: "Ante operationem, dixi me organizationi secretam iungendum esse, antequam identitatem sororis meae assumam.

source: To seek revenge, I invited members of that secret organization to assist.
target: Ut ultio petenda esset, membra illius organizationis secretae ad auxilium convocavi.

source: I believe you all have seen or sensed their presence.
target: Credo vos omnes eorum praesentiam videritis aut sensistis.

source: He strategically linked the appearance of the Tarot Club to himself, safeguarding Franca’s identity as a Minor Arcana card holder.
target: Ille apparationem Tarot Club ad se coniunxit, ita identitatem Francae ut tenentis cartae Minor Arcanae servans.

source: “And which organization is that?” Gandalf inquired curiously.
target: "Et quae organizatione illa est?" Gandalf interrogavit cum curiositate.

source: As per Hela’s account, the secret organization exhibited Angel-level power, and the demigod “Cinderella” who appeared at sea was equally formidable.
target: Secundum Helae relationem, organizationes secretae potentiam ad angeli gradum exhibuerunt, et semideus "Cinderella", quae in mari apparuit, similiter formidabilis erat.

source: “The Tarot Club,” Lumian revealed truthfully.
target: "Tarot Club," Lumian veraciter revelavit.

source: “You’re one of the Minor Arcana card holders?” Gandalf deduced.
target: "Esne unus ex tenentibus cartarum Minor Arcanae?" Gandalf congetavit.

source: He had heard about the Tarot Club.
target: Audiverat de Tarot Club.

source: Lumian nodded without denying it.
target: Lumian annuit sine negatione.

source: Curiosity piqued, Franca asked, “Which card represents that ‘Cinderella’ demigod? And why does her magic have such a dreamy quality? Moreover, it resembles fairy tales from before our transmigration!”
target: Excitata curiositate, Franca rogavit: "Quae carta illud semideum 'Cinderella' repraesentat? Et cur magia eius talem qualitatem somnifera habeat? Praeterea, fabulis priores ante nostram transmigrationem similis est!"

source: She maintained her role while genuinely expressing curiosity.
target: Illam partem suam servavit, dum vere sincera curiositatem exprimebat.

source: Lumian recalled Madam Magician’s guidance and grinned.
target: Lumian recordatus est consilium Dominae Magicae et subridens dedit.

source: “Major Arcana card, The Hermit.”
target: "Carta Maior Arcana, Eremita."

source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “I’m uncertain about why she can transform your fairy tales into magic.
target: Intermissis momentis, addidit: "Nescio cur illa fabulas vestras in magiam convertere possit.

source: What I do know is that she’s closely tied to Emperor Roselle’s descendant.”
target: Quod scio est eam arcte coniunctam esse cum descendantibus Imperatoris Roselle.

source: “Descendant of Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette?” Franca and the others, having read numerous entries from Roselle’s diary, immediately speculated.
target: "Descendens ex filia maiori Imperatoris Roselle, Bernadette?" Franca et ceteri, ex multis Rosellae commentariis lectis, statim coniectaverunt.

source: “Perhaps, but it’s not Bernadette herself,” Lumian honestly disclosed.
target: "Forsitan, sed ipsa Bernadette non est," Lumian sincere revelavit.

source: That was the extent of his knowledge.
target: Id erat totum scientiae eius.

source: “Is that so…” Franca, Gandalf, and Hela felt enlightened.
target: "Sic est..." Franca, Gandalf, et Hela se omnia perspicua sentierunt.

source: So, it was connected to Emperor Roselle’s faction!
target: Ergo, hoc erat coniunctum cum factione Imperatoris Roselle!

source: It made sense for the Emperor to create fairytale magic.
target: Rationabile erat imperatori magiam fabularum condere.

source: After a brief pause, Lumian suggested, “You should probably prevent the Research Society from disseminating those fairy tales.”
target: Post brevem moram, Lumian suadivit: "Censeo vos impedire debere disseminationem harum fabularum a Societate Investigationis."

source: “Understood,” Gandalf agreed.
target: "Intelligo," Gandalf assentivit.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment before stating, “I’ve concluded my involvement with the Research Society and have joined another secret organization. It’s no longer suitable for me to participate in the Research Society’s gatherings. You may find an opportunity to reveal the truth to the other members.”
target: Lumian breve meditatus est antequam dixerit: "Participationem meam in Societate Investigationis finivi et in aliam organizationem secretam accessi. Iam mihi non convenit conventibus Societatis Investigationis interesse. Vos fortasse occasionem invenietis ad veritatem aliis membris revelandam."

source: Gandalf and Hela exchanged glances and proposed, “You can continue playing the role of Muggle and acquire resources and assistance from the Research Society. We owe it to your sister.”
target: Gandalf et Hela conspectum inter se commutaverunt et proposuerunt: "Munus Muggle agere pergere potestis et opes atque auxilium ex Societate Investigationis adipisci. Id sorori tuae debemus."
